# Dragoon Mods

> Severed Chains mods, installation help, game data and local asset tools

## Agent resources

- [Guide](https://dragoonmods.com/agent/guide.md): Navigation, versions, installation and browser tools
- [Catalog](https://dragoonmods.com/agent/mods.md): Curated build-time mods and release links
- [Manifest](https://dragoonmods.com/agent/index.json): JSON catalog and complete game-data endpoint discovery
